name: agenteur
description: Coordinate Claude Code and Codex sessions with durable tasks, messages, leases, and notifications.

hooks.command: for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -f "$r/scripts/run.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/scripts/run.sh" session-start; done; exit 0

monitors.name: events
monitors.description: agenteur messages and task updates for this session's agent
